name: Susisuchus
sum: Susisuchus is a neosuchian crocodyliform from the Early Cretaceous of Brazil, closely related to Eusuchia.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: A single partial articulated skeleton of S. anatoceps from the Nova Olinda Member of the Crato Formation, lacking most hind-limb bones; catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: The holotype, the most complete known specimen, plus fragmentary remains of S. jaguaribensis from the Lima Campos Basin.
exceptional: Traces of soft tissue; the carcass was probably desiccated before burial.
biology: The sources consulted describe its anatomy and burial but give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Salisbury et al. 2003
